map.撞击坑标度律（π-scaling）：D 为坑径、L 为撞击体直径、v 为撞击速度: Impact-crater scaling law (π-scaling): D is crater diameter, L the impactor diameter, v the impact velocity, θ the impact angle and ρᵢ/ρₜ the impactor-to-target density ratio; released energy E ≈ ½mv².
map.大面积区域破坏，类似通古斯事件: Large-area regional destruction, similar to the Tunguska event
map.以撞击点为中心的破坏区域示意图（对数比例）: Schematic of damage zones centered on the impact point (logarithmic scale)
map.示意图采用对数比例显示，实际范围差异巨大: The schematic uses a logarithmic scale; actual ranges differ enormously
map.m = 陨石质量 = ρ x (4/3)π(d/2)³ （ρ密度，d直径）: m = meteorite mass = ρ x (4/3)π(d/2)³ (ρ density, d diameter)
map.TNT当量 = E / 4.184 x 10⁹ （1吨TNT = 4.184 x: TNT equivalent = E / 4.184 x 10⁹ (1 ton TNT = 4.184 x 10⁹ J)
map.L = 陨石直径（m）、v = 撞击速度（m/s）: L = meteorite diameter (m), v = impact velocity (m/s)
map.瞬态坑 > 2.5 km 时按 D: When the transient crater > 2.5 km, use D
map.折减为塌陷后的最终坑: reduced to the final collapsed crater
map.基准校验：直径 50 m、速度 13 km/s 的铁陨石（ρ=7800）→ 坑径: Benchmark check: an iron meteorite of diameter 50 m at 13 km/s (ρ=7800) → a crater of about 1.2 km, matching Barringer Crater measurements. This is a simplified model; real crater formation involves complex fluid dynamics and phase changes.
map.（6600万年前）：直径约10km陨石，速度20km/s，坑径180km，导致恐: (66 million years ago): a ~10 km meteorite at 20 km/s, 180 km crater, causing the extinction of the dinosaurs
map.（1908年）：约60m天体，空中爆炸，释放约15百万吨TNT当量: (1908): a ~60 m object airburst, releasing about 15 megatons of TNT equivalent
map.（5万年前）：50m铁陨石，坑径1.2km，位于美国亚利桑那州: (50,000 years ago): a 50 m iron meteorite, 1.2 km crater, located in Arizona, USA
map.（2013年）：20m天体，空中爆炸，释放约500千吨TNT当量: (2013): a 20 m object airburst, releasing about 500 kilotons of TNT equivalent
map.本工具为教学用简化模型，估算结果仅供参考。实际撞击坑形成涉及超高速碰撞、相变、冲: This tool is a simplified educational model; estimates are for reference only. Real crater formation involves complex physics such as hypervelocity impact, phase change and shock waves.

map.科普或行星地质研究中估算撞击坑的量级。: Estimate the order of magnitude of impact craters for outreach or planetary-geology research.
map.直径 1 km、密度 3000 kg/m³、速度 20 km/s 的陨石（靶岩: A meteorite of diameter 1 km, density 3000 kg/m³ and speed 20 km/s (target rock 2700 kg/m³, 45° impact): kinetic energy about 3.1×10²⁰ J, transient crater about 11 km, and final collapsed crater about 16 km.
map.为经验缩放关系，受入射角与靶岩性质影响。基准校验：50 m/13 km/s 铁陨: It is an empirical scaling relation, affected by impact angle and target-rock properties. Benchmark check: a 50 m / 13 km/s iron meteorite → about a 1.2 km crater, matching Barringer Crater measurements.
map.有。松散沉积层形成的坑径更大，坚硬基岩则相对较小。: Yes. Loose sedimentary layers form larger craters, while hard bedrock forms relatively smaller ones.
